title: Google Play requires new apps/updates to target API level 37 (Android 18)
summary: Following Google's established yearly cadence (API level 36 became mandatory August 31, 2026), Google is expected to require new apps and updates to target API level 37 for Play Store distribution around August 2027.

sources.title: Target API level requirements for Google Play apps

title: EU AI Act full compliance deadline for pre-existing general-purpose AI models
summary: Providers of general-purpose AI models already on the market before August 2, 2025 have until August 2, 2027 to reach full compliance with the EU AI Act's GPAI obligations.

title: DEF CON 35
summary: DEF CON confirmed via its own account that DEF CON 35 runs August 5-8, 2027 at the Las Vegas Convention Center.
